name: company-brain-harness
description: Portable Company Brain harness skills and CLIs for filesystem-backed knowledge roots.

interface.shortDescription: Connect, stage, approve, and score a company brain.
interface.longDescription: Portable workflows and helper CLIs for operating a company brain on any filesystem-backed root, with privacy-safe capture, staged promotion, health checks, onboarding, meeting intake, and repo-aware POC guardrails.
defaultPrompt: Use $brain-setup to scaffold a new company brain.
Use $brain-health to check this company brain.
Use $sources-check to validate org-wide source instances.
Use $brain-schedule to create the operating schedule.
Use $brain-lint to inspect freshness and provenance.
